career_spells.employer: University of Sydney — Mosaic staff network
career_spells.evidence_note: UNSW speaker biography identifies Sitou as a Mosaic founder while working in university media. The university’s March2019 application names her as co-chair at the March2019 launch; this is a dated service observation, not her appointment date. SAGE records that the network was created in2018, but does not individually date her founding or chair service. Staff-network leadership is documented separately from her substantive media job. Sources do not establish separate remuneration, hours or cessation. The application also confirms she had participated in the VC Sponsorship Program by March2019; this is professional development, not another job.
career_spells.counting_note: Governance/association activity within a university staff network is excluded from the employment headlines; do not double-count it as separate full-time university employment or infer unpaid status from silence.

research_notes: Resolve pre-2009 work, Parliament House employer and campaign pay, exact Community Alliance placement dates/terms, Clare appointments, AusAID payroll/contract/hours, university dates/hours/leave/control and doctoral overlap; date DAWN and Chinese Australian Forum governance.

2026-09-29 initial avenues: APH indexed chronology, frozen roster, 2010 ACYD profile, Whitlam and UNSW biographies, University of Sydney 2017–18 employer yearbook, DFAT mid-term-review annexes, first-speech reproduction and explicit full-time/employer searches. Government report identifies AusAID media work more precisely than generic international-development descriptions.

AYAD placement described as a year associated with 2008 in contemporary profile; do not invent its end or infer full-time paid Commonwealth employment. A later press search lead references Beijing in 2009; obtain programme placement record before resolving boundary.

Do not import third-party January 1 date normalisations. Preserve APH year precision. University sector and full-time employment require evidence, while PhD status remains study unless a separate employment contract is found. Partial record requires follow-up.

2026-10-01 follow-up: searched early work, paid/volunteer campaigning, AusAID contracts, university hours/leave, public professional profiles and DAWN; reread contemporary ACYD, party candidate announcement, first-speech reproduction and her Parliament House recollection. No additional paid employer or contract hours established. Added explicit 2007 volunteer campaign, 2021 training and CAF project leadership, and material 14-month parental-leave evidence from two Hansard speeches.

Next leads: university personnel or public first-person account specifying 2016-era leave and return dates/hours; early Parliament House employer/contract (do not merge with Clare 2009–2012); AusAID appointment contract and China placement record. Full-time and part-time phrases in adjacent Hansard speakers or third-party LinkedIn posts are not Sitou’s employment evidence. Dynamic contact cards attached to older university news pages do not backdate doctoral enrolment.

Second follow-up2October2026: added LEAN NSW federal patron role from organisation announcement; AusAID photographic work corroborated by UN Women without treating the UN as employer. Targeted Samoa, university part-time and DAWN searches did not resolve contracts, hours or leave dates. UN photo taken/upload chronology conflicts and was not used for employment dates. Search excerpts for university part-time study refer to her electorate staff, university vice-chancellor or other delegates, not Sitou. Parental-leave repost repeats already documented14-month absence without new boundaries. Continue employer-specific leave/return and early Parliament House appointment evidence; no employment totals inferred.

Third follow-up3October2026: repeated exact-name searches for the pre-2009 Parliament House employer, Jason Clare appointment boundaries, AusAID Samoa contract and University of Sydney parental-leave/return evidence. Contemporary ACYD again establishes a2010 Australian Government policy-adviser point and one year in Beijing in2008 but does not name the employing office or add boundaries beyond existing spells. A University of Sydney April2014 conference program credits media-outreach advice, consistent with the documented2013 start but not a contract, hours or leave record. The paid-parental-leave speech supplies no dates beyond the already recorded14-month absence. No new supported employer, boundary, hours or leave allocation found; advance the cursor and avoid repeating these queries without a new archive or employer record.

Fourth follow-up4October2026 narrowed searches to Penny Wong/Parliament House, 2007 employment, Jason Clare appointment timing and AusAID Samoa media work. Results repeated the existing first-person Parliament House recollection, Whitlam biography and DFAT review annex. A 2025 social-media thank-you to Penny Wong does not identify her earlier employer and was not used to infer staff service. No appointment instrument, payroll entity, contract boundary, hours or leave allocation was found. Further progress requires parliamentary staffing records, AusAID personnel material or University of Sydney employment/leave documentation; repeated biography queries are exhausted.

Follow-up2026-10-04: New university SAGE application documents Mosaic co-chair service at the March2019 launch, distinct from media employment; UNSW biography supports founding. Network creation2018 is not an individual appointment date. VC sponsorship is training, not another employer. Personal dates, pay/hours and cessation remain unknown. Co-founder CV retrieval returned HTTP503 and web find Internal Error; not used to fabricate a2018 appointment. AYAD and early staffing queries repeat earlier evidence; retain recorded gaps.
